status_note: The eight targeted JumpTable::sanityCheck/recoverAddresses projections are byte-identical MATCH against locked Ghidra 12.0.4, including exact exception text and the complete address/load/loadcount/partial state at each catch point. Fixture overall remains MISMATCH under JUMPTABLE-PIPELINE-0001 because the production Rugra flow/funcdata stage still consumes the legacy bool/Option adapter instead of the typed recovery result, so FailThunk is not yet propagated through the real stageJumpTable closure.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: sanityCheck receives vector<int4>* loadcounts and passes the same object by reference to JumpModel::sanityCheck; addresstable, loadpoints and partialTable are JumpTable members mutated in place and remain observable when JumptableThunkError/LowlevelError unwinds. Rugra passes Option<&mut Vec<i32>> and the member Vecs directly, returns JumpTableRecoveryError::{Thunk,Lowlevel} with the exact explain text, and deliberately does not roll back model mutations on Err.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: sanityCheck order is override return -> snapshot size -> isReachable -> single-entry thunk check -> model sanity -> successful-size warning. isReachable examines at most two predecessor levels (i=0,1), requiring exactly one in-edge and a two-way constant CBRANCH guard. recoverAddresses performs recoverModel/getTableSize/buildAddresses/sanityCheck in that order and only then collapses collected loads; the fixture's reject path proves collapse is skipped on error.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The saved table size is captured after the override early return and before reachability/thunk/model checks, and is consulted only after model sanity succeeds. The absolute target/op offset difference is computed once for a single entry and compared strictly greater than 0xffff. Fixture recover/build/sanity counters start at zero per case and increment at their exact call sites; override records recover=1/build=1/sanity=0, while thunk cases never increment model sanity.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: The table-level thunk discriminator is keyed first by addresstable.size()==1, then target offset==0 or the unsigned absolute offset difference from indirect->getAddr() > 0xffff; address-space identity and target ordering do not participate. Multi-entry tables bypass this discriminator even when entry 0 is zero/far. LoadTable::collapseTable, reached only after successful sanity, sorts by Address then size and merges contiguous same-size entries; 0x3000 and 0x3004 therefore become 0x3000/4/2 only in the override success case.

overlays.policy: primary file under test; raw SHA-256 pinned by comparand.jumptable_overlay_sha256

single_target_boundary.covers: zero throws typed thunk with exact 'Likely thunk'; near succeeds; a difference exactly 0xffff succeeds; 0x10000 throws typed thunk; model sanity is skipped on both thunk cases.

multi_target_bypass.covers: A two-target table containing zero and a target 0x20000 away bypasses the table-level thunk discriminator and reaches model sanity once.

partial_before_thunk.covers: A collapsed constant-false predecessor marks partialTable before the zero single target throws, and the partial mutation remains visible at the thunk catch point.

override_short_circuit_and_collapse.covers: recoverAddresses reuses the override model, builds a zero target, sanityCheck returns before reachability/thunk/model sanity, partial stays false, and successful collect-loads processing collapses 0x3000/0x3004 into one two-entry LoadTable.

lowlevel_partial_mutation.covers: Model sanity truncates two addresses to one, appends load 0x3008 and loadcount 7, then returns false; ordinary LowlevelError text is exact, all mutations survive, and loadpoints remain uncollapsed.

production_typed_stage_consumption.covers: Ghidra Funcdata::stageJumpTable catches JumptableThunkError separately and returns fail_thunk; Rugra production callers still consume recover_addresses/try_recover through bool/Option compatibility adapters, so the typed recovery mode is lost before the production stage.

residuals.detail: The typed classifier and direct recoverAddresses projection match, but this task's write-set excludes flow/funcdata; production must still migrate to try_recover_classified/recover_addresses_classified and preserve FailThunk separately from FailNormal.

branches.detail: Legacy bool/Option compatibility collapses both JumpTableRecoveryError variants, whereas locked stageJumpTable has distinct JumptableThunkError and LowlevelError catch clauses.
